comment: Canonical cross-language test vectors for the licenses contract. Inference vectors are order-sensitive on purpose: licenses that name other licenses in their own body (MPL-2.0 and EPL-2.0 name the GNU family as Secondary Licenses, GPL-3.0 section 13 names the AGPL, the SPDX LGPL-3.0 text appends the whole GPL-3.0 text) must not be identified as the license they merely mention, and supersets follow the license they contain (BSD-3 before BSD-2, ISC before 0BSD). The trailing vectors are excerpts of the real SPDX texts carrying exactly those traps; the full texts of all 17 allowed ids were checked against this table.
